description: Wallet history on Arc: the last 50 transfers in and out of an address over about 3 days, decoded (time, direction, from, to, token, amount, USD at the time of the transfer and today) plus net flow per token (accumulating or distributing). USDC counted once from native transfer logs; NFTs listed; impostor USDC/EURC and address poisoning (lookalike addresses, events the sender never signed) flagged. A failed read is refused before payment. $0.003 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

before.description: optional: a block number; returns the page ending at it (each answer gives next.before)

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

name: arc_wallet_history
